name: Circuito básico
_doc: Test course as data (tool 5 of Lote 1). Frame: metres from the take-off point (n north, e east) and alt = height over the ground. Hand-written copy of CourseLayout.Default() in Assets/Scripts/Telemetry/Sim/TestCourse.cs (the C# is the source of truth). pad: the «H» (r in m). gates: rings whose normal is azimuthDeg (0 north, 90 east, 180 south) and that must be crossed along it. zones: boxes (half sizes in n and e, altitude range). pylons: vertical cylinders from the ground (r, h). wall: axis-aligned boxes (n0..n1, e0..e1, altMin..altMax) that leave a 5 m x 5 m gap. checkpoints: the ordered list of one lap, the last one is the finish (the zone over the pad). route: [n, e, alt] waypoints of the intended lap for the verification flight (not drawn). constants: the test radii and the take-off height; startRadius is the distance from the pad within which the take-off starts the lap.
